description: This file defines the interface for a Dictionary class used in an Android input method, including constants, class declaration, and method signatures related to dictionary management and word suggestion functionalities.

classes.name: Dictionary
classes.description: A class representing a dictionary used for word suggestions and validation in an Android input method.

methods.name: Dictionary
methods.description: Constructor for the Dictionary class, initializes with dictionary buffer and multipliers.

methods.name: getSuggestions
methods.description: Returns suggested words based on input codes, considering various constraints.

methods.name: isValidWord
methods.description: Checks if a given word of specified length is valid in the dictionary.

methods.name: setAsset
methods.description: Associates an asset with the dictionary.

methods.name: getAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the address in the dictionary data.

methods.name: getTerminal
methods.description: Checks if the current position is a terminal node for a word.

methods.name: getFreq
methods.description: Retrieves the frequency of a word at the current position.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Retrieves the count value at the current position.

methods.name: getChar
methods.description: Retrieves a character from the dictionary data at the current position.

methods.name: wideStrLen
methods.description: Calculates the length of a wide string.

methods.name: sameAsTyped
methods.description: Checks if a word matches the typed input.

methods.name: addWord
methods.description: Adds a word to the dictionary with a specified frequency.

methods.name: getWordsRec
methods.description: Recursively retrieves words from the dictionary.

methods.name: isValidWordRec
methods.description: Recursively checks if a word is valid in the dictionary.
